During 2024, she visited the surgery with symptoms that were clear red flags that the cancer has metastasised. She was sent away each time with no plan to see why these symptoms were occurring. Still in agonising pain, she attended broomfield hospital A&E on 11 October having had no care whatsoever from this surgery. On 7 December she passed away from stage 4 liver cancer. Please expect my official complaint about your fatal incompetence.
Edit 30 December 2025.
The surgery absolutely refuse to let me have her medical records. Without these I cannot make my complaint fully. They know this. I wonder why they won't release them? We have had no cases matching the description you have given. Please contact us directly to discuss and investigate, Kind Regards, Amy Winter, Practice Manager 

Dear Mrs Sanderson,
With any release of records requests there are very clear national processes that have to be followed. It is imperative that patient confidentiality is maintained. When anyone requests medical records, we provide them with a clear set of guidelines to follow in order that we can release the records appropriately.
